notes.title: CATCAT is out now!!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone!  [/p][p]After more than a year of development, our first game is finally released![/p][p] [/p][p]Compared to the demo version, we've made many improvements:[/p][p]Adjusted the speed of dragging toys.  [/p][p]Added many more cat behaviors.  [/p][p]New toys: a juice extractor and a robot vacuum cleaner.  [/p][p]As well as more furniture, cats, and wallpapers.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lastly,  [/p][p]If you have any questions or issues, feel free to reach out to us![/p][p] [/p][p]Discord：[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/pupnqVh7Gx"]https://discord.gg/pupnqVh7Gx[/url][/p][p][/p][p]QQ Group：[/p][p][url="https://qm.qq.com/q/bpi7OpkX5K"]https://qm.qq.com/q/bpi7OpkX5K[/url][/p][p][/p]
